chapters.label: The brave block, live
chapters.text: Istanbul, 2023, the Champions League final. City lead Inter. Gosens heads the cross back, Lukaku heads from two yards... saved by Ederson! The ball breaks loose, and Rúben Dias heads it away. Corner!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. It bounces off Ederson's knee to Dias. He twists his whole body and steers it wide of his own goal.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: Out for a corner! City held on and won their first Champions League.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: be brave. Get your body in the way of the shot, and keep your arms behind you.
